games.name: [Russia] Musketry
games.desc:
Musketry is a team deathmatch game set during the Napoleonic Wars, inspired by Blood and Iron.

Take part in battles across a variety of realistic and fictional settings, fighting alongside your nation to overcome the opposing forces and secure victory.

Choose from a wide range of classes, each offering different weapons and roles on the battlefield. Customize your character to your liking and find a playstyle that suits you.

Fight alongside your friends, coordinate with your teammates, and use tactics to gain the upper hand against those foolish enough to stand against your nation.

If you enjoy Musketry, consider leaving a like and adding the game to your favorites. Your support helps us continue developing the game and bringing new content and improvements.

games.name: Disease Spread Simulation
games.desc:
*
A silent killer is spreading fast. Can you stop it in time?
Strategize, contain and eradicate the disease with various equipment.
Use medicine, equipment and machines to save patients and stop the disease spreading.
*

*
The game starts with 100 NPCs plus players.
One person is infected.
The infection spreads to people nearby, especially those unprotected.
Lucky infected people become immune.
Immune people lose their immunity and the fallen are replaced.
The cycle continues until there are no infected.
Have fun.
